summary: Digital Currency X Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for May 13, 2026, to vote on a series of share capital reduction and reorganization proposals. The proposals include reducing par value from US$3.6 to US$0.0001 per share, subdividing authorized unissued shares, canceling excess authorized shares, and subsequently increasing authorized share capital from US$83,333.33 to US$300,000. These actions are routine capital structure adjustments under Cayman Islands law, not a special situation event. No price, premium, or external transaction is involved. This is a standard corporate housekeeping filing.
